items.lede: Prime minister says he told Sam Altman he was disappointed it had taken OpenAI ‘way too long’ to disclose breach Anthony Albanese says an artificial intelligence agent developed by OpenAI hacked Medicare in June and the tech giant notified the government earlier this month using an email sent to a “public mailbox”. items.title: Albanese says OpenAI hacked Medicare and told Australia months later via email to generic inbox

items.lede: Albanese said he expressed "concern" to OpenAI founder Sam Altman, after authorities were informed three months after the breach in June.
items.title: OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website, PM says
